title: PrestaShop Modules
meta: A custom PrestaShop module that adds the feature your store or customers need, written in clean PHP. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Custom PrestaShop modules for the feature you are missing
overview: When no module on the market fits, we write one for your PrestaShop store. Typical examples are a custom product field, a delivery date picker, a special discount rule, a supplier import or a link to your warehouse. We code to PrestaShop standards using hooks, test on a duplicate store, and give you the finished module with settings in the back office and notes your next developer can follow.

pkgs.blurb: One small module for a single, clear feature.
A module with a back office settings page and tests.
A larger module with data tables, API links and full handover.
list: Up to 4 features in one module
Source code handed over with docs

faq: Should I buy a ready made module instead?
Often, yes. Before we build, we check the market for a maintained module that fits. If one exists, we can install and configure it for much less than custom work.
Will the module work after PrestaShop updates?
We follow current standards, which helps. Major version changes may need small edits later. We note which parts could be affected in the documentation.
You do. We hand over the module code and notes, and you can have any PrestaShop developer extend it.
Do you need access to my live store?
No, not at first. We build and test on a duplicate store, then install on the live shop once you approve, using collaborator or staff access and never your password.
